summary: Twelve games were played. Atlanta beat Charlotte 128-81 and led by as many as 49, and Dallas led Indiana 77-43 at the half before winning 121-105. Utah beat New Orleans 120-119 on two free throws with 50 seconds left, Houston beat San Antonio 114-110 after 14 lead changes, and Memphis closed on a 17-4 run to beat Golden State 111-108. Jayson Tatum and Giannis Antetokounmpo each scored 36.

games.headline: Bulls erase 15-point deficit, beat Bucks 132-125
games.story: Milwaukee led 26-11 in the first quarter, a 15-point lead, but Chicago outscored the Bucks 44-30 in the second and trailed 62-61 at the half. The game was tied at 123 with 1:16 left, and the Bulls closed on a 9-2 run to win. Norman Powell scored 25 for Chicago and Caleb Wilson had 21 points and 6 rebounds. Tyler Herro scored 34 for Milwaukee on 12-of-24 shooting, and Jaime Jaquez Jr. had 19 points, 11 rebounds and 5 assists.

games.headline: Tatum scores 36 as Celtics beat Knicks 107-103
games.story: The game was tied at 47 late in the second quarter, and Boston outscored New York 33-24 in the third. The Celtics took the lead for good at 55-54 early in the third and led by as many as 12 in the fourth. Jayson Tatum scored 36 on 14-of-26 shooting with 9 rebounds and 7 assists. Karl-Anthony Towns had 22 points and 10 rebounds for the Knicks, and OG Anunoby had 20 points, 10 rebounds and 8 assists.

games.headline: Raptors never trail, beat Wizards 112-102
games.story: Toronto scored first and never trailed, opening 34-21 after the first quarter and leading by as many as 17 in the second. Washington cut the margin to 78-77 late in the third quarter but got no closer. Scottie Barnes scored 28 with 14 rebounds and 5 assists, and RJ Barrett had 23 points. Trae Young led Washington with 22 points and 12 assists, and the Wizards had 20 turnovers.

games.headline: Hawks rout Hornets 128-81, lead by as many as 49
games.story: Atlanta went ahead for good at 11-9 in the first quarter and led 68-43 at the half. The Hawks outscored Charlotte in every quarter and led by as many as 49 late in the fourth. Jalen Johnson had 19 points, 8 assists and 7 rebounds, and Aaron Wiggins scored 19 on 7-of-9 shooting. Charlotte made 11 of 51 three-point attempts and had 25 turnovers.

games.headline: Timberwolves beat Magic 115-93, led by 26 in third
games.story: Minnesota led from 6-5 in the first quarter and was up 57-45 at the half. The lead reached 26 late in the third, and Orlando outscored the Timberwolves 33-29 in the fourth. Jaden McDaniels and Anthony Edwards scored 15 each, with Edwards shooting 5-of-23, and Rudy Gobert had 14 points and 9 rebounds. Wendell Carter Jr. led Orlando with 20 points on 8-of-9 shooting.

games.headline: Mavericks open 44-27 and beat Pacers 121-105
games.story: Dallas scored 44 points in the first quarter and led 77-43 at the half, a lead that reached 37 late in the second quarter. The Mavericks went ahead for good at 14-11 early in the first. Indiana outscored them 62-44 in the second half. Kyrie Irving scored 24 with five three-pointers, and P.J. Washington had 20 points, 13 rebounds and 3 blocks. Pascal Siakam led Indiana with 23 points.

games.headline: Pistons beat Heat 128-111 despite Antetokounmpo's 36
games.story: Detroit scored first and never trailed, scoring 41 in the first quarter and leading by as many as 23 in the third. John Collins scored 23 with five three-pointers and Paul Reed had 19 points and 11 rebounds. Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 36 for Miami on 15-of-26 shooting with 12 rebounds and 5 assists. Cade Cunningham had 8 assists for Detroit.

games.headline: Rockets edge Spurs 114-110 behind Sengun's 29
games.story: There were 14 lead changes, and San Antonio never led by more than one point. The score was tied at 101 with 4:58 left, and Houston went ahead for good at 105-104 with 3:49 to play. Alperen Sengun scored 29 on 10-of-20 shooting with 7 rebounds and 7 assists, and Amen Thompson had 20 points and 10 rebounds. Victor Wembanyama scored 25 with 13 rebounds and 2 blocks for San Antonio, and De'Aaron Fox had 19 points and 9 assists.

games.headline: Jazz edge Pelicans 120-119 on late free throws
games.story: Utah led by 15 early in the third quarter, and New Orleans outscored the Jazz 38-24 in that period. The Pelicans led 119-118 with 1:01 left, and Utah made two free throws at 0:50 for the 120-119 final. Neither team scored again. Jaren Jackson Jr. scored 24 with 10 rebounds and 3 blocks, and Keyonte George had 19 points and 10 assists. Zion Williamson scored 23 for New Orleans.

games.headline: Grizzlies finish on 17-4 run to beat Warriors 111-108
games.story: Golden State led 104-94 with 3:47 left in the fourth quarter, and Memphis outscored the Warriors 17-4 the rest of the way. The Grizzlies went ahead for good at 105-104 with 1:24 left. Ty Jerome scored 28 for Memphis and Cameron Boozer had 25 points, 13 rebounds and 6 assists. Stephen Curry scored 24 for Golden State, and Yaxel Lendeborg had 18 points, 13 rebounds and 6 assists.

games.headline: Lakers pull away in third to beat Clippers 125-117
games.story: The teams were tied at 64 at the half. Los Angeles outscored the Clippers 39-26 in the third quarter and went ahead for good at 71-69 with 9:42 left in that period. The lead reached 15 early in the fourth. Austin Reaves scored 28 on 10-of-13 shooting with 9 assists, Luka Doncic had 23 points and 7 assists, and Walker Kessler had 22 points, 8 rebounds and 6 blocks. Darius Garland led the Clippers with 26 points.

games.headline: Trail Blazers score 44 in third, beat Kings 128-120
games.story: Sacramento led 64-59 at the half, and the score was tied at 64 early in the third quarter. Portland outscored the Kings 44-26 in the period and went ahead for good at 66-64. Deni Avdija scored 26 for Portland and Toumani Camara had 19 points with five three-pointers. Darius Acuff Jr. scored 33 for Sacramento, and Domantas Sabonis had 27 points, 19 rebounds and 10 assists.
